crossRefs.note: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about…
Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
“If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself…
If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and…
Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

translations.web: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
translations.bsb: If I am not doing the works of My Father, then do not believe Me.
translations.kjv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
translations.asv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
